name: Media Manager
tagline: Owns a YouTube video's after-work: captions, chapters, titles and thumbnail prep.
description: Once a video is live, this takes over the housekeeping: it produces the transcript, writes captions and chapter timestamps, drafts title and description options, and prepares thumbnail directions so the post-upload grind is handled in one place.
author: shao__meng
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
